turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I've been digging through some recent bug reports. Did you see the one about KV block corruption under rapid lora alternation?
I haven't reviewed that specific one yet. Do you have the issue number handy?
Yeah, it's GitHub issue #38606. Looks like the memory manager isn't flushing properly when switching adapters too quickly.
That sounds like a tricky race condition. I'll make a note to look into the flush logic.
Thanks. Also, do we still have any of those USB-C to HDMI adapters in the supply closet? My laptop port is acting up.
I believe there are two left on the second shelf, right next to the spare SSDs.
Great, I'll grab one. The weather is awful today, so I'm staying in anyway.
It does look like heavy rain is forecasted for the rest of the afternoon.
Yeah, perfect day to debug this adapter issue. Talk later.
Good luck with the debugging. I'll keep an eye on that issue.
Lloyd, quick question on the new release pipeline. Does the CI eval wall apply to AgentX releases?
Yes, it does. All major version bumps for AgentX must pass the CI eval wall before merging.
Got it. I want to make sure we don't break the build time limits. Did we optimize the test suite recently?
We parallelized the integration tests last month, which cut the runtime by about 30%.
Nice. By the way, did you order the new mechanical keyboards for the team yet?
The order was placed yesterday. Shipping is estimated for next Tuesday.
Awesome. I'm running low on coffee too, so maybe I'll stop by the supply room after the standup.
The new Ethiopian blend just arrived, so it's a good time to restock.
Perfect. Thanks for the update on AgentX.
You're welcome. Let me know if you need the specific eval metrics.
